deviations.reason: Gate 4 (task-reference lint) passes cleanly. Gate 3 (doc-lint) reports FAIL, but for two reasons both structurally outside this phase's own scope: (a) deployed-vs-source script content drift for git-commit-phase.sh and test-git-commit-phase.sh, which are Phase 1/2's already-committed source-store changes awaiting Phase 4's redeploy, not new drift from this phase's doc edit; (b) an index-entries.json line-count mismatch for git-staging-scope.md caused by this phase's own edit, whose remediation script (generate-context-line-counts.sh --write) refuses to run from the source-store tree by design and only operates against a deployed scripts/ tree -- confirmed empirically by invoking it directly. deploy-headless.sh (run in Phase 4) runs this line-count generator automatically before every deploy, so both causes of gate 3's FAIL resolve together at Phase 4's redeploy, which Phase 4 already closes on via its own unnarrowed verify-deploy.sh run.
deviations.annotation: *(completed: gate 4 passes; gate 3's full pass deferred to Phase 4's redeploy and full gate run)*
